findings.headline_summary:
RBI Monetary Policy Committee (MPC) Operating Framework
Reserve Bank of India Monetary Policy Committee Operating Framework: The policy repo rate under the Liquidity Adjustment Facility (LAF) serves as the anchor rate for money market interest rates. The Standing Deposit Facility (SDF) rate operates at repo rate minus 25 bps (6.25% when repo is 6.50%), and the Marginal Standing Facility (MSF) operates at repo rate plus 25 bps (6.75%). The MPC targets medium-term consumer price index (CPI) headline inflation of 4.0% within a +/- 2.0% tolerance band.

Reserve Bank of India Monetary Policy: Repo Rate 6.50% & Liquidity Stance
Reserve Bank of India Monetary Policy Committee Statement: The MPC decided by a 5 to 1 majority to keep the policy repo rate unchanged at 6.50%. Consequently, the standing deposit facility (SDF) rate remains at 6.25% and the marginal standing facility (MSF) rate and Bank Rate at 6.75%. The stance of monetary policy was unanimously revised from 'withdrawal of accommodation' to 'NEUTRAL'. Cash Reserve Ratio (CRR) of scheduled commercial banks is maintained at 4.50% of NDTL.

stress_tests.circuit_filter_boundary: PASS: Maximum single-day price move of 4.25% strictly within NSE 20.0% circuit boundary.
stress_tests.volatility_shock_test: PASS: 2x volatility jump (65.0%) results in daily 99% VaR of 9.53% within 15.0% stress limit.
stress_tests.statutory_drag_test: PASS: Sample return (53.70% ann) comfortably covers 22.22 bps statutory friction.
stress_tests.liquidity_contraction_test: PASS: Under 50% turnover drop (INR 442.65 Cr), estimated market impact 3.4 bps remains <= 25.0 bps threshold.
stress_tests.lookahead_leakage_audit: PASS: Point-in-time timestamp matching verified across 125 bars with zero future leakage.

circuit_filter_boundary.expected_condition: Maximum trailing single-day absolute price move <= 20.0% (NSE statutory circuit filter)
circuit_filter_boundary.explanation: PASS: Maximum single-day price move of 4.25% strictly within NSE 20.0% circuit boundary.
circuit_filter_boundary.limitations: Corporate actions or split unadjusted bars trigger false circuit breaches.

volatility_shock_test.expected_condition: Annualized realized volatility <= 80.0% and 2x shocked 99% parametric daily VaR <= 15.0%
volatility_shock_test.explanation: PASS: 2x volatility jump (65.0%) results in daily 99% VaR of 9.53% within 15.0% stress limit.
volatility_shock_test.limitations: Assumes log-normal return distribution; tail heaviness under shock may underestimate kurtosis.

statutory_drag_test.expected_condition: Sample annualized return strictly covers Finance Act 2024 statutory friction drag (22.22 bps)
statutory_drag_test.explanation: PASS: Sample return (53.70% ann) comfortably covers 22.22 bps statutory friction.
statutory_drag_test.limitations: Historical sample mean return does not guarantee forward alpha realization.

liquidity_contraction_test.expected_condition: Turnover under 50% contraction >= 25.0 Cr and stressed market impact <= 25.0 bps
liquidity_contraction_test.explanation: PASS: Under 50% turnover drop (INR 442.65 Cr), estimated market impact 3.4 bps remains <= 25.0 bps threshold.
liquidity_contraction_test.limitations: Parametric Kyle's lambda proxy; order book queue depth omitted to prevent numerical fabrication.

lookahead_leakage_audit.expected_condition: All bar timestamps strictly <= decision cutoff timestamp (zero lookahead leakage)
lookahead_leakage_audit.explanation: PASS: Point-in-time timestamp matching verified across 125 bars with zero future leakage.
lookahead_leakage_audit.limitations: Relies on database partition metadata accuracy and DuckDB analytical query bounds.
